newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian stocks seen marking time, await jobs.
newsitem.headline: Australian stocks seen marking time, await jobs.

text.p: SPI Sycom cl 2627 -1 US 30yr cl 6.84 steady
*Stocks seen marking time ahead of May employment data, due 11.30 a.m. (0130 GMT). "The jobs numbers are the thing today. You shouldn't see too much ahead of that," said a Sydney dealer.
*On Wall Street a broad rally saw blue chips make it four records in a row while other indices reversed Tuesday's losses.
*ADRs: News Corp 18 (+1/4), BHP 28-3/8 (-1/2), WMC 24-3/4 (-1/4), National Australia Bank 71-1/2 (-7/8)

*Gold price was steady, on LME copper rallied to a 13 month high, buoyed by positive technicals. Nickel firmed early but failed to sustain the momentum, ending weaker. Rest were steady. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
